infotexts.midiplayer.title: MIDI Player
infotexts.midiplayer.nofiles: No MIDI files found! Install 'MIDI Storage' from Workshop
infotexts.midiplayer.volumehint: * Volume: Esc -> Settings -> Mod Gameplay Settings *
infotexts.midirange.help: midirange [100..50000] - show instrument sound range or set it as the host. Default: 1000.
infotexts.midirange.changed: Instrument sound range set to [range] and saved. Applies to new notes.
infotexts.midirange.invalid: Usage: midirange [100..50000]. Enter one whole number.
infotexts.midirange.hostonly: Only the host can change instrument sound range. On a dedicated server, use the server console.
infotexts.midirange.waiting: Requesting instrument sound range from the server...
infotexts.midirange.savefailed: Instrument sound range set to [range], but could not be saved. It will reset after restarting.
infotexts.midijamrange.help: midijamrange [100..50000] - show the Play Together radius or set it as the host. Default: 2000.
infotexts.midijamrange.changed: Play Together radius set to [range] and saved. Applies immediately.
infotexts.midijamrange.invalid: Usage: midijamrange [100..50000]. Enter one whole number.
infotexts.midijamrange.hostonly: Only the host can change the Play Together radius. On a dedicated server, use the server console.
infotexts.midijamrange.waiting: Requesting the Play Together radius from the server...
infotexts.midijamrange.savefailed: Play Together radius set to [range], but could not be saved. It will reset after restarting.
infotexts.midijamrange.outofrange: The performer is outside the Play Together radius ([range]).
infotexts.midijamrange.left: Play Together stopped: the leader is outside the radius of [range].
infotexts.midispw.title: Soundproof Walls — MIDI
infotexts.midispw.tooltip: Add notes to XML Ignored Sounds and Reverb Forced Sounds and save SPW settings. Existing entries are preserved; duplicates are skipped.
infotexts.midispw.changed: Added notes to XML Ignored Sounds and Reverb Forced Sounds. SPW settings were saved and applied. You can edit these lists in SPW later.
infotexts.midispw.unchanged: notes is already in both lists. No duplicates were added.
infotexts.midispw.uploaded: Local lists were saved. Settings containing notes were sent to the server through SPW and will apply after synchronization.
infotexts.midispw.serveroverride: notes is in both local lists, but the server's SPW settings currently control audio. The host or a player with Manage Settings permission must press this button to add notes to the server lists.
infotexts.midispw.unavailable: Soundproof Walls is not loaded. Enable SPW and C# mod support in LuaCs, then reload mods.
infotexts.midispw.failed: Could not finish applying SPW settings. See the console for error details and check the SPW lists before trying again.
